# DivinityAI

> Quran and Hadith question answering with grounded, citation-backed answers.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://muslim.nevatal.id/
- API: https://muslim.nevatal.id/api/
- API Catalog: https://muslim.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://muslim.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://muslim.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://muslim.nevatal.id/auth.md
